nodes.label: Liquidity Comovement Monitor
nodes.rationale: PCA on 5-minute bucketed first-differenced standardized spreads. Rolling Comovement Factor as leading indicator for systemic stress (SSRN-2337523).

nodes.label: Phantom Liquidity Detection (PLI)
nodes.rationale: Phantom Liquidity Index compares canceled-to-executed volume. High ratio indicates unreliable funding depth. PLI used as fill probability filter in PaperTradingEngine.

nodes.label: Behavioural Risk Index (BRI)
nodes.rationale: Tracks herding, panic, overconfidence via order book microstructure and sentiment. 5th axis on Systemic Risk Heatmap. Herding Filter suppresses signals during Extreme Herding periods.

nodes.label: Intraday Liquidity Pattern (Reverse U-Shape)
nodes.rationale: TimeOfDayThresholdManager makes signal thresholds adaptive based on time-of-day. Tighten during high-asymmetry open/close; relax mid-day. Liquidity-aware execution delays signals 1-2 intervals at open/close.

nodes.label: Defining Range (DR) Session Filter
nodes.rationale: Price range between 9:30-10:30 AM EST has 85% probability of containing intraday high or low (SSRN-4492355). Signal confidence decays during +/-30 min of high-impact news.
